name: Raindrop
desc: Bookmark manager to save, search, and organize content from the web

actions.name: create_raindrop
actions.description: Saves a new bookmark to your Raindrop.io account

actions.name: get_raindrop
actions.description: Retrieves the details of a bookmark by its ID

actions.name: update_raindrop
actions.description: Updates the details of an existing bookmark

actions.name: delete_raindrop
actions.description: Moves a bookmark to the trash. To permanently delete it, empty the trash in Raindrop.io.

actions.name: find_raindrops
actions.description: Lists bookmarks from a collection, with optional keyword search

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
